prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return ES module solution.ts.
Required API: export function backpressureActions(samples:number[][]):string[]|null
Behavior: Each sample is (queued,capacity,consumerReady). queued and capacity must be integers in 0..10,000,000; consumerReady is the integer flag 0 or 1 only. Emit DROP when queued exceeds capacity, SEND when queued is positive and ready is 1, PAUSE when queued is positive and ready is 0, otherwise IDLE.
Visible example: samples (6,5,1),(2,5,1),(2,5,0),(0,5,0) return DROP,SEND,PAUSE,IDLE.

Buggy source to repair:

export const backpressureActions=(..._x:any[]):any=>null;

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
